question.problem:
$$
{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,5)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{{x}^{4}}, & \,x\le -1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=5]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,5)$ is shown above and the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{X|5}=-\frac{3}{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =\text{E}[(X-{\mu }_{X|y})^{2}\,|\,Y=y] \\  & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=5] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,5)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{-1}{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{3}{{x}^{4}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{-1}\frac{3}{{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{-1}3{x}^{-2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[-3\cdot {x}^{-1}]}_{-\infty }^{-1} \\  & ={[-\frac{3}{x}]}_{-\infty }^{-1} \\  & =3-0 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=5] & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=5]-{\mu }_{X|5}^{2} \\  & =3-{(-\frac{3}{2})}^{2} \\  & =3-\frac{9}{4} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
